reasoning_content: Now I'm going to set up Apache as a reverse proxy to route the three Tomcat services on their internal ports (8180, 8181, 8182) along with MapServer's CGI on port 8080, which is where the deegree service expects it to be at the localhost endpoint. The webapps.properties mapping in the shared deegree workspace root handles all the context-to-workspace routing, so moving tomcat-dienste to internal port 8180 will work fine with this single-file approach. My plan is to stop the Tomcats, update their ports and the MapServer URL in the workspace, restart everything, and configure Apache as a reverse proxy on 8080 to route all the service contexts to their new internal ports. I should also check if the xplan-validator-web workspace has any MapServer dependencies that need updating.
